composition: Use decisive subject hierarchy and intentional negative space
Alternate sculptural portrait framing with environment-led wide frames
For groups, build readable geometric relationships rather than even spacing
lighting: Choose one legible lighting idea per scene
Use controlled contrast and shaped falloff to separate subject from environment
Preserve skin, fabric and product texture without flattening the image
color: Use a restrained dominant palette with one purposeful accent
Keep color continuity across adjacent segments
Allow monochrome only when form, expression and tonal separation carry the story
pose_and_motion: Direct poses through silhouette, gesture and tension rather than generic smiling
Give each moving shot one clear visual action and one narrative function
environment_and_narrative: Treat location, objects and wardrobe as story evidence
Build progression from intrigue through transformation to a resolved final image
typography: Use typography as an editorial composition element, not a generic subtitle layer
Prefer solid high-contrast display serif or disciplined solid sans-serif faces with a clear hierarchy
Use asymmetrical placement, intentional scale and generous negative space
Choose a restrained high-contrast ink color on light imagery or solid ivory on dark imagery; pure black is optional, not a default
Keep display copy short enough to remain legible at phone size
Create deliberate scale contrast between an oversized expressive display word and a small restrained editorial index
Allow italic tension, cropped letterforms and changing text axes when they reinforce the shot composition

story_skeleton_contract.rule: Each of options A, B and C must interpret the principles differently while preserving evidence-based narrative beats.

shot_selection_contract: Every selected shot must declare narrative_function and visual_function
Prefer a purposeful mix of portrait, detail and environment evidence
Reject decorative shots that do not advance subject, transformation or resolution

claude_review_contract.blocking_originality_rule: REVISE when the work appears to reproduce an identifiable reference image, publication layout, photographer signature, or campaign execution instead of applying abstract principles.

contrast_pairs: deep ink blue on pale or white imagery
solid charcoal when the image requires neutrality

color_strategy.dominant_text_color: derive one deep ink tone from the campaign palette
color_strategy.secondary_text_color: use a quieter mineral or neutral relative of the dominant tone
color_strategy.accent_limit: one purposeful accent color may appear once at the reveal or resolution
prohibited: pure black as an unquestioned universal default

art_direction_required: at least one deliberate tension device such as italic, crop, offset or axis change
avoid: same centered title treatment on every shot

research_provenance.usage: internal study only; no publication or redistribution rights implied
